age.label: Age
age.description: 0 to 0.2 = a white egg on its bulb, the stipe stretches from 0.2 to about 0.7, the veil tears at 0.48, the cap opens from 0.45 and is convex to flat at 1. A random once per path gives every mushroom its own

cap_radius.label: Cap radius
cap_radius.description: Radius of the open cap, the stipe takes its length and width from it. Read for every stipe

length.label: Length
length.description: Length of the grown stipe as a share of the diameter of the open cap, read for every stipe

stout.label: Stout
stout.description: Radius of the grown stipe in its middle as a share of the radius of the open cap, read for every stipe. A button has a thicker stipe for its size

bulb.label: Bulb
bulb.description: How much wider the bulb at the base is than the stipe, read for every stipe. The bulb is twice as long as its radius, the stipe narrows into it

age.label: Age
age.description: 0 to 0.2 = a white egg on its bulb, the stipe stretches from 0.2 to about 0.7, the veil tears at 0.48, the cap opens from 0.45 and is convex to flat at 1. A random once per path gives every mushroom its own

radius.label: Radius
radius.description: Radius of the open cap, read for every stipe

color.label: Veil
color.description: The white universal veil over the flesh, the warts are what is left of it

reach.label: Reach
reach.description: Radius of the largest cap, the pattern of the gills covers it

t.label: Time
t.description: The gills turn from white to cream with it

depth.label: Depth, open
depth.description: Depth of the gills of an open cap, read for every stipe

age.label: Age
age.description: 0 to 0.2 = a white egg on its bulb, the stipe stretches from 0.2 to about 0.7, the veil tears at 0.48, the cap opens from 0.45 and is convex to flat at 1. A random once per path gives every mushroom its own

length.label: Ring length
length.description: How far the ring hangs down once the veil has torn from the margin

ring_button.label: Ring height, button
ring_button.description: Where the veil holds on the stipe on the button, as a share of the stipe from its base

ring_open.label: Ring height, open
ring_open.description: Where the ring sits on the open mushroom, as a share of the stipe from its base: real rings sit high, just under the gills

reach.label: Reach
reach.description: Radius of the largest cap, the warts cover it

age.label: Age
age.description: 0 to 0.2 = a white egg on its bulb, the stipe stretches from 0.2 to about 0.7, the veil tears at 0.48, the cap opens from 0.45 and is convex to flat at 1. A random once per path gives every mushroom its own. The red shows through the white veil of the egg as the cap swells

t.label: Time
t.description: The red turns a little more orange with it

spacing.label: Wart spacing
spacing.description: How far apart the warts are, as a share of the reach. A small young cap shows the middle of the pattern, where the warts lie close together, an open one also its margin, where the cracks between them are wide

height.label: Wart height
height.description: How far the warts stand above the red cuticle in the middle of the cap, they flatten towards the margin and with age

bulb.label: Bulb
bulb.description: How much of the stipe the bulb takes, from its base

length.label: Length
length.description: How far the scaly girdles stand out on the upper bulb of a grown mushroom
